summary: No installer-side threat identified in litellm 1.107.0
details: litellm 1.107.0 is a Python LLM gateway/proxy library. No install-time or import-time code paths were observed that exfiltrate installer secrets, fetch and execute remote payloads, open a backdoor, redirect the installer's package manager, or distribute live third-party credentials. No lifecycle hooks performing network I/O, no.pth side effects beyond sys.path handling, and no credential-harvesting primitives against installer-owned paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores) were found in the shipped artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
